added.title: Director of Engineering and Product Development
added.description:
The Opportunity

Our client is an innovative, privately held consumer products company with a global customer base and a strong track record of bringing differentiated products to market. The company is entering an exciting stage of growth, with an expanding pipeline of new products and opportunities to enter additional consumer categories.

To support that growth, the organization is seeking a Director of Engineering & Product Development
to lead the technical development of products from early-stage concept through commercialization and ongoing production.

This is a highly visible leadership role with significant influence over the company's product roadmap. The successful candidate will combine strong engineering judgment, hands-on product development experience, manufacturing expertise, and executive-level communication
to help turn ideas into commercially successful products.

This is an opportunity for an experienced product development leader to have a meaningful impact in an entrepreneurial environment where decisions can move quickly and individual contributions are highly visible.

The Role

Reporting directly to the company's senior leadership team, the Director will own the engineering and product development process across the product lifecycle - from initial concept and prototyping through design for manufacturing, tooling, validation, production launch, and ongoing product improvement.

The role will serve as the bridge between product vision, engineering execution, and manufacturing
, ensuring that products meet customer needs while remaining technically sound, cost-effective, reliable, and scalable for production.

Product Development Leadership

Lead the full lifecycle of consumer product development, from ideation and concept development through prototyping, design for manufacturing, tooling, validation, production launch, and ongoing improvement.
Translate product concepts and business objectives into clear technical requirements, development plans, and execution priorities.
Partner closely with senior leadership to shape the product roadmap and determine technical feasibility, development priorities, and resource requirements.
Maintain visibility across the product development portfolio, identifying risks and opportunities and ensuring projects remain aligned with business objectives.

Engineering & Technical Leadership

Provide technical direction across mechanical, electrical, firmware, product design, and manufacturing disciplines.
Establish product requirements and make informed engineering trade-offs related to performance, reliability, cost, manufacturability, and time to market.
Lead design reviews, risk assessments, validation activities, and other technical decision-making throughout the development process.
Bring a practical, hands-on approach to resolving complex product and engineering challenges.

Manufacturing & Supplier Partnerships

Serve as a key technical partner to overseas manufacturing partners and engineering resources.
Ensure alignment on product specifications, quality expectations, development schedules, tooling, costs, and production requirements.
Support production readiness and work closely with Operations to resolve quality, yield, reliability, and other manufacturing issues.
Help expand and strengthen the company's global manufacturing capabilities, including opportunities to diversify its manufacturing footprint.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering and product development team.
Establish clear goals, accountability, development processes, and performance expectations.
Build and continuously improve product development processes, documentation, design standards, and phase-gate disciplines appropriate for a fast-moving consumer products environment.
Evaluate team structure, resources, and external capabilities to ensure the organization can effectively support its growing product pipeline.
Manage engineering and product development resources in alignment with commercial priorities.

Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Participate as a member of the senior leadership team and provide clear, data-driven visibility into product development progress, risks, priorities, and mitigation plans.
Work collaboratively across functions and global time zones to keep development programs moving toward defined scope, schedule, cost, and quality objectives.
Provide a technical and manufacturability perspective during portfolio, product roadmap, and strategic business discussions.
Communicate complex technical considerations clearly to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

10+ years of experience
in engineering and/or product development, ideally within consumer products such as toys, consumer electronics, mechanical devices, or other highly engineered physical products.
Demonstrated success taking multiple products from concept through mass production
.
Significant experience working directly with overseas manufacturing partners.
5+ years of experience leading and developing engineering or product development teams.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of design for manufacturing, tooling, validation, production readiness, and commercialization.
Ability to operate comfortably at both the strategic and hands-on levels.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Located within reasonable commuting distance of the New York City area, with the ability to work in the office 2-3 days per week. Periodic international travel will also be required.

The Ideal Leader

The strongest candidates will likely have experience in a small to mid-sized consumer products environment
where engineering leaders are expected to do more than manage a team.

This role is particularly well suited for someone who enjoys building. You will have the opportunity to strengthen the product development organization, introduce greater structure and discipline, influence the company's future product portfolio, and help bring new products from an idea on a whiteboard to something customers can actually use.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for an engineering and product development professional who wants meaningful ownership, visibility, and influence in a growing consumer products business.

added.description:
About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Millions of people across the world come to Pinterest to find new ideas every day. It’s where they get inspiration, dream about new possibilities and plan for what matters most. Our mission is to help those people find their inspiration and create a life they love. As a Pinterest employee, you’ll be challenged to take on work that upholds this mission and pushes Pinterest forward. You’ll grow as a person and leader in your field, all the while helping users make their lives better in the positive corner of the internet.

Pinterest is looking for a Senior Manager, Ads Product Marketing - Ads Automation to lead a key area of our ads delivery and automation product marketing strategy. In this role, you will help shape how Pinterest brings automation solutions to market, enabling advertisers to better understand performance, value Pinterest media accurately, and improve business outcomes. You will work at the intersection of product, market, and customer needs, translating ads delivery and automation complexity into clear strategy, positioning, and go-to-market execution.

As a senior leader on the Ads Product Marketing team, you will oversee a team responsible for advancing Pinterest’s automation capabilities across areas such as bidding, targeting, or creative. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing Science, and Business Development to influence roadmaps, guide launches, and drive adoption of solutions that help advertisers automate how to reach their performance goals on Pinterest.

What You’ll Do

Lead product marketing strategy and execution for a core area of Pinterest’s automation portfolio
Manage and develop a team of PMMs responsible for complex, cross-functional automation and delivery initiatives
Use advertiser needs, market trends, customer feedback, and competitive insights to shape recommendations and influence partner roadmaps
Drive positioning, messaging, go-to-market planning, and launch execution for automation and delivery products and capabilities
Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing Science, and Business Development to align on priorities, readiness, and success metrics
Help advertisers maximize performance through adoption of our suite of automated solutions
Define and track success metrics for launches and ongoing adoption, using data and feedback to refine strategy over time
Build the processes, forums, and cross-functional operating rhythms needed to keep high-priority initiatives moving effectively
Translate complex ads delivery and optimization concepts into clear narratives for internal stakeholders, sales teams, and advertisers

What We’re Looking For

Significant experience in advertising, ad tech, product marketing, measurement, delivery, or a closely related field
Deep expertise in digital ads delivery and the broader automation and performance ecosystem, including areas such as bidding, optimization, delivery, automation, or related solutions
Experience leading go-to-market strategy for complex products or solutions with multiple cross-functional stakeholders
Experience using customer insight, market analysis, and performance data to shape strategy and influence product direction
Strong people management experience, with a track record of coaching and developing high-performing teams
Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment across Product, Sales, and other partner teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for different audiences
High judgment, strong prioritization skills, and comfort operating in ambiguity
Experience using AI and analytical tools to accelerate research, synthesis, and execution, with strong judgment around accuracy, quality, and ownership of final outputs
A passion for Pinterest
Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

In Office Statement

We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6-months and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from one of our office hubs based in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Seattle or New York.

This position is not eligible for relocation assistance.

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

added.title: Sr. Product Manager - Advisor Experience
added.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead and shape Addepar’s Advisor experience for Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs). In this role, you will own the surface area, features, and capabilities designed specifically to empower wealth managers to acquire, retain, and advise their end-clients across web and mobile platforms.

You will analyze early user feedback and adoption metrics to establish and execute a clear long-term roadmap. Sitting at the intersection of integrated ecosystem tools, like CRMs, Addepar data and technology, and AI, you will leverage artificial intelligence to turn platform data into tailored, context-aware insights for individual clients. Partnering closely with engineering, product design, user research, and client-facing teams, you will build and refine the tools and workflows that simplify daily operations for advisors.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

What You’ll Do

Build a deep understanding of the Advisor persona within the RIA segment, learning how their daily workflows connect across the broader Addepar platform.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners and stakeholders to author a long-term product direction across mobile and web surfaces.
Partner closely with AI and engineering teams to refine AI-powered insights, ensuring they are tailored and contextually relevant for financial advisors.
Translate high-level business goals into clear, detailed requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that empower engineering teams to deliver with confidence.
Monitor key adoption and engagement metrics to evaluate feature performance, refine workflows, and continuously elevate the Advisor experience.
Articulate the core purpose and value behind each product initiative, ensuring go-to-market teams are equipped to drive client success.

Who You Are

You have 5 or more years of experience in Product Management. You have navigated the full lifecycle, from launching new applications and features from the ground up to scaling and optimizing established products.
You have practical experience incorporating AI/ML capabilities into workflow applications to deliver personalized user outcomes and streamline routine tasks.
You have prior experience in wealth management, fintech, or the RIA ecosystem, experience working with front-office wealth advisors is a plus.
You thrive in the cross-functional partnership across Product, Design, Engineering, and Client Success to solve complex problems and deliver intuitive user experiences.
You balance qualitative user insights with quantitative analytics to prioritize effectively, make sound decisions, and adapt your approach as new evidence emerges.
You excel at articulating the why behind every feature. You empower stakeholders and go-to-market partners with the narrative they need to effectively communicate value to our clients.

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States.

Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Base Salary Range

$142,000—$223,000 USD

Our Values

Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

About The Role.

The Senior Product Development Manager role will lead a wide range of key initiatives that drive strategic insurance product innovation and development for the personal Property products. This important leadership role will focus on creating, enhancing and maintaining the Property lines of business and product features that meets evolving member needs, expands profitable growth, and ensures continued market relevance.

What You’ll Do.

Lead the product development for all assigned products, leveraging deep expertise of the insurance business and product, that influence decisions across the organization
Leads teams in understanding the link between PURE’s vision and strategies and department initiatives through a product development lens to ensure progress towards company objectives
Ideate, design and implement new or enhanced products with complex product features.
Contribute to the consistent iteration of long-term product roadmaps for assigned products, with an appropriate cadence of updates to pricing, contract, selection and all other product features
Manage the identification, exploration, and nurturing of new and existing strategic partnerships to offer a more robust suite of products
Conduct internal and external research to identify emerging trends, member needs and review competitor offerings to inform product innovation
Drive cross-functional collaboration with Underwriting, Claims, Marketing, Sales and all other stakeholders to successfully and efficiently design and develop enhancements to the product suite
Build strong relationships with Technology to define detailed system requirements and collaborate continuously throughout the build to ensure new and revised product builds, features and tools are delivered as designed with high level of quality
Proactively consider the comprehensive member and broker experiences for any touchpoint in the design of a given product and support processes to continuously improve these experiences
Collaborate with the Actuarial Pricing, Data & Analytics, and State Product Management departments to develop different models using internal and external data to inform product pricing and risk selection decisions
Identify, explore, and support the pursuit of external data sources that could provide value to our products
Develop and manage the work of analysts that report directly to them (if applicable)
Mentor and be a thought leader for managers and analysts across our Product teams
Act as a subject matter expert on committees/external panels/forums/rate hearings

What We’re Looking For.

10+ years relevant work experience in P&C insurance product management required with demonstrated increased responsibilities over time. High net worth personal lines insurance experience preferred, but not required
Bachelor’s degree required, ideally in an analytical field of study such as Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science, Math, Statistics or Risk Management
Deep knowledge of the P&C insurance industry, competitors, insurance product pricing, financial drivers of profitability; comprehensive understanding of legislative and insurance regulation
Extensive understanding of product, underwriting and distribution and how each impacts the other.
Exceptional ability to analyze data and dashboards to draw useful insights and develop strategies and recommendations.
Superior critical and analytical thinking, quantitative and problem-solving skills with the ability to make and influence data-based decisions
Established experience leading teams and important initiatives through a consultative leadership style and growth mindset
Outstanding oral and written communication skills with a proven ability to engage and inspire various audiences, while establishing executive presence
Highest Level of integrity and honesty

‌

We're a member-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. We provide exceptional service, hospitality and care, we partner with our members to help prevent losses and we create smart insurance solutions at fair prices.

We aim for our members to love their insurance . It is our mission is to create a membership experience so compelling that our members never want to leave.

Who We Are

We want to be transparent about what we expect from each other. From PURE, you can expect:

Opportunities to stretch and grow: your professional and personal development matters to us. We’re committed to providing experiences through on-the-job learning and professional development that increase your impact and rewards.

Clarity and kindness: you can rely on us to be open, honest and supportive, offering clarity on what success looks like.

Support in good times and bad: we believe in showing up for each other consistently, not only when it’s easy. You can expect a thoughtful partner, even when we disagree.

A community that cares: we are committed to sustaining a community in which each person feels cared for as an individual. We lift each other up, celebrate wins together and support one another through challenges in work and life.

Who You Are

All of the strongest relationships are a partnership- a two way street. So here’s what we ask of you:

Aim to bring your best every day: you’re here because you want to be part of a team that makes a real impact and aims high.
Be a student and a teacher: share your knowledge and talents and be willing to listen and learn from those around you.
Get comfortable being uncomfortable: we face tough moments and obstacles with a “courage over comfort” approach and a positive, solutions-oriented mindset.
Be a culture builder: building a positive culture is everyone's responsibility, based on care, respect and openness to diverse perspectives.

Areas that support the identification and development of the product offerings for the business. Impacts the team's ability to achieve service, quality and timeliness of objectives. Subject to Product Management policy objectives. Has independence in achieving Product Management objectives within operating budgets and operating guidelines. There is moderate autonomy within the role to enter into/execute Product Management arrangements. High levels of judgment are required to achieve outcomes required.

Job Description

About us:

GE Renewable Energy is one of the world's leading offshore wind energy companies, with a portfolio of offshore wind turbines ranging from 6 MW to 14 MW that offer increased value to customers with proven performance, reliability, efficiency and availability. We have invested more than $400 million to develop the Haliade-X, an investment that will also drive down offshore wind farms’ levelized cost of energy, helping make offshore wind energy more competitive for our customers. The Haliade-X was the industry’s first 14MW offshore wind turbine to operate, and is the only 12+MW offshore wind turbine platform that has been operating for over two years, specifically at its Rotterdam prototype site.

Why We Come To Work

Driven and ambitious, our Sales teams are well-equipped to be on the front line, closing deals, meeting commercial objectives, and working with our customers day in, day out. They’re smart people, entrusted with the autonomy to make great decisions and deliver their passion. If you’re looking for a sales role where you can be truly proud of what you’re selling, where your driven nature can be put to good use, and where you can build genuine, strong relationships with customers and colleagues alike, then bring your skills to our Sales teams. You’ll enjoy the tremendous satisfaction of being part of a team making a change for good.

Essential Responsibilities

The Sr Product Management Manager - Operations:

Drives initiatives to improve the effectiveness of the Product Management function and interfaces with other functions to provide effective coordination of metrics, dashboards, functional processes, and cross-functional initiative coordination.
Requires specialized knowledge across product lines, markets, sales processes, or customer groups. Requires strong Product awareness and is expected to influence the development of strategy for their broad sales territory, including control of resources.

Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.

VP, Product Management, Later Influence

Boston, MA; Chicago, Illinois, United States; Los Angeles, California, United States; New York, New York, United States; Remote; San Francisco, California, United States; Toronto, Ontario, Canada; Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada; Vancouver, Washington, United States

Later is the world's most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing's most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data, including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases, Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Learn more at later.com.

About this position:

As VP of Product Management for Later Influence, our agency and brand-facing enterprise influencer marketing product, you'll shape and drive the strategy that helps brands and creators collaborate at scale with predictable, measurable business results. Later Influence combines AI, first-party data across campaigns, creators, and content, and workflow automation to deliver full-funnel campaigns from discovery to conversion. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer and leading Product Manager(s) directly, you'll build a high-impact product organization, shaping the roadmap and user experience while optimizing for growth, stickiness, and commercial impact. This is a pivotal, high-visibility role in scaling Later's creator economy proposition, with responsibility for transforming Later Influence into an AI-native Programmatic Influencer platform, and regular exposure to senior leadership.

What you'll be doing:

Strategy

Own the vision and strategy for Later Influence, connecting brands, creators, and commerce through AI, our proprietary data, and rich creator commerce signals.
Become an expert in the end-to-end execution of influencer campaigns, driving improvements that streamline planning and strategy, campaign kickoff and setup, creator discovery and vetting, campaign workflow and content collaboration, payments management, and reporting and insights.
Monitor, share, and translate insights from customer needs, creator economy news, social networks, commerce trends, and partnerships into a roadmap that drives measurable business outcomes, reduces human-in-the-loop hours to deliver a campaign, and improves the quality of the customer experience.
Partner with the CPO, cross-functionally with Engineering, and across stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships to align product strategy with company objectives and targets.
Define, monitor, and report progress toward key metrics that cascade throughout the product teams, including impacts to campaign delivery, creator earnings, and company revenue.
Serve as the product champion for how Later Influence uniquely delivers value, including our creator network of 20M+ and 200k high-affinity creators and over $1.5B in GMV.

Execution & Technical Leadership

Lead end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation, discovery, and MVP through scaling and ongoing optimization, delivering solutions that help brands find, engage, pay, and measure creators and campaigns at scale.
Deepen our AI capabilities and advance our product toward our AI Programmatic vision through strong partnership with our data and engineering teams.
Build and manage strong product processes, leveraging tools such as Linear for product backlog and delivery and Domo (or similar) for analytics and monitoring.
Prioritize features and investment based on expected outcomes and data, such as campaign performance, cohort-based churn, and revenue growth, while maintaining a consistent focus on ROI and product-market fit.
Ensure the platform's UX, workflow, automation, and analytics match the enterprise expectations of brand marketers, including campaign workflow automation, message automation, creator application and review, and payments.

Team & Collaboration

Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing product team (Product Managers, Product Ops, Design) focused on Later Influence, setting clear goals, career paths, and accountability.
Collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and our Creator Network team to ensure a cohesive go-to-market, onboarding, and renewals motion.
Work closely with peer product, design, and research leaders, including the SVP of Product, Creator, to share best practices, ensure product synergy across the ecosystem, and avoid silos.
Foster a culture of positivity, proactiveness, and ownership, ensuring the team is motivated, aligned, and accountable.

Thought Leadership & Market Insights

Stay ahead of influencer marketing, creator economy, social media platform, and commerce trends, including challenger insights, creator behaviors, and new social platforms.
Translate market and competitor insight into product differentiation and speed-to-market advantages.
Represent Later Influence externally, including with customers, analysts, partners, and PR, as the product leader who understands our value and can articulate it in the market.

What success looks like:

The platform makes meaningful progress toward Later's vision of a Programmatic Influencer Platform, becoming an increasingly differentiated enterprise offering.
A clear, compelling roadmap is in place, with defined milestones showing improved customer outcomes and strong alignment with leadership stakeholders.
Within the first 6-12 months, you've delivered measurable progress toward AI transformation of the program execution workflow and driven impact to primary product metrics.
The product team operates with elevated velocity, demonstrable expertise and customer insight, credibility, predictable delivery, clear prioritization, and measurable impact.
Internal stakeholders across Sales, Strategy, Marketing, Design, Research, Partnerships, and Customer Success experience a product organization that reliably plans and delivers value across the customer lifecycle, driving time and cost optimization and unlocking new, differentiated capabilities through Later's proprietary data and AI.

What you bring:

We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If you identify with any of the following, we encourage you to apply!

10+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or platform-led businesses, including 5+ years in senior leadership owning full product lines.
Proven track record scaling enterprise SaaS or marketplace-platform products, ideally in influencer marketing, creator economy, social, or commerce-adjacent AdTech/MarTech.
Skilled at turning customer and market insights into product strategy and revenue growth; comfortable with metrics such as ARR/ACV growth, churn, LTV/CAC, and conversion funnel, and experienced with analytics and visualization tools to drive data-led decisions.
Strong experience building and scaling product teams and processes in high-growth companies.
Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of working successfully with engineering, design, marketing, customer success, and sales in a fast-moving environment.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to explain complex technical matters to business stakeholders and represent the product externally.
Proactive, positive, growth-oriented leader who thrives in ambiguity and fast iteration in a scale-up environment.
Demonstrable experience and experimentation with AI across the product management lifecycle, including vibe coding internal tools and customer-facing prototypes.

How you work:

**How we work:**
We will do whatever it takes to win: We win when our customers and creators win. We bring full commitment to outcomes that matter, not just effort.
We have no limit to our aspiration: We think big, push beyond what seems possible, and refuse to let conventional thinking set the ceiling.
We are relentless: We keep going. Through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities, we find a way forward.
We deeply understand our business: If we don't have the knowledge, we figure it out. We take ownership of understanding how Later works and what drives results.
We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: We bring rigor and accountability without ego, and we make space for each other to do our best work.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Director, Product Delivery

Overview

U.S. Product Delivery (USPD) leads the overall program implementation of Mastercard products and services to customers in partnership with key constituents of the payment’s ecosystem. This includes dynamic problem solving and management of both business and technical aspects for product delivery while leading the entire project team toward successful product deployments. USPD is focused on integrating product delivery experience, learnings and market knowledge back into Mastercard product management to help drive our business forward.

This role is responsible for leading the successful implementation across Commercial and New Payment Flows (CNPF). This USPD team member plays a critical role in aligning delivery efforts with customer needs and market dynamics, while continuously optimizing implementation processes based on hands-on experience and industry insight. The role also involves close collaboration with global/regional product and global delivery teams, ensuring customer feedback translates into actionable improvements that reduce time to market (TTM), accelerate revenue, and enhance overall customer satisfaction.

Develop and lead key strategic delivery relationships and priorities within US Markets, including existing products and first-time deployments of new products, services and technologies not widely distributed in market.
Become an integrated strategic partner and key contributor to relevant Product, Implementation, Account, Technology at both Mastercard and our Customers.

Manage and oversee customer and internal Mastercard project teams (direct/indirect) as they progress through solution development and delivery. Superior customer and industry relationship management skills and ability to build and maintain strong, positive working relationships at all functional levels within client organizations and internal Mastercard organizations are essential.
Demonstrated experience prioritizing and allocating resources to optimize efficiency and drive peak performance

Proven ability to lead change at all functional levels. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) that can present relevant information to different audiences as appropriate. The role requires the ability to present to internal and client senior executive management as well as functional business partners.
Extensive project/program management, problem solving and planning skills with a demonstrated record of success managing multiple projects simultaneously with clients and internal business partners.
Ability to thrive and effectively collaborate in a dynamic, fast-paced, team environment that embraces giving, receiving as well as acting on feedback.

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Senior Product Manager, AI CI/CD

The Role, In a Nutshell

Chainguard secures the software supply chain, and we're standing up a new team to build a new product inside it.

Agents now write a large and growing share of the world's code, and they inherited a CI system designed for humans who push a few times a day. Write, push, wait in a queue, reinstall the same toolchain, scrape the logs, try again. Agents iterate far more often than people do, so they feel every minute of that, and the workarounds they've grown are worse than the thing they're working around. We don't think the fix is a faster version of the CI you already have. We think CI gets rebuilt for agents, and that's what we're doing.

The product isn't launched, so a job post is the wrong place for the details. What we can tell you now: the team is small, the hard technical pieces already run in production inside Chainguard, and you'd be driving the product direction.

What You'll Own

Strategy and roadmap. Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the product. Decide what we build first, what comes next, and what we're not going to do.
0→1 product work. Take this from a system that works for us to a product customers buy and use. Bring structure to problems that don't have any yet, make the tradeoff calls, and get things in front of users before they feel finished.
How agents actually build software. Go deep on how developers and their agents write, test, review, and ship code today, including the parts nobody blogs about. Most of what's written about agentic development is aspirational. You'll work from what people really do.
Design partners. Find the teams whose agent fleets are big enough to hurt, get the product into their hands early, and turn what they tell you into priorities.
Developer experience. Adoption is the whole game here. Own how the product gets tried, configured, and lived with, so a team can move onto it without running a migration project.
Launch. Positioning, naming, docs, the pricing model, and the story, with Product Marketing and the rest of Product. You're also the person who says when it's ready.
Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Engineering, Experience, Product Marketing, and other Product leaders, and keep a small team pointed at the same thing while the space shifts underneath it.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of product management experience on developer-facing, infrastructure, security, or similarly technical products.
You've built agent tools. Something agents use, or something people use to build with agents: a coding agent, an agent framework or harness, MCP servers, eval systems, or developer tooling meant to be driven by a model instead of a person. This is the requirement that matters most to us.
You know CI from the inside. Builds, tests, caches, runners, artifacts, merge gates, and the specific reasons pipelines end up slow, flaky, and expensive. You should have opinions about why.
You don't need to be a GitHub Actions expert. We're not building a better Actions, and years of workflow YAML isn't the experience we're hiring for. Knowing where it breaks is.
Experience taking a technical product from an early idea through launch and iteration.
Judgment about what to leave out. A new product dies from doing too much as easily as from doing too little.
Comfort with a deeply technical engineering team. You can hold your own in a design discussion and disagree with an engineer about a tradeoff.
You talk to developers directly and often, and you can tell the difference between technology people find interesting and a product they'll actually adopt.
You write well. We make decisions in documents here.
You can operate on your own in a fast-moving area with no established playbook.

Nice to haves

You've run coding agents in production at real volume, or built the systems that keep them from breaking things.
Experience with developer platforms, build systems, remote execution, or hosted development environments.
Experience with containers, Kubernetes, registries, or other cloud-native infrastructure.
You've built security products for developers, and you know how fast a developer abandons one that gets in the way.
Experience with products that serve individual developers and large enterprises at the same time.
You've owned your own team's CI at some point and hated it.

Explore Our Work

Dive into the practical side of what we do at Chainguard. These resources provide a hands-on look at our processes and offer an opportunity for in-depth understanding of our product offerings and the technology behind them.

Chainguard Academy
https://www.chainguard.dev

Base Salary Range

$205,000—$231,000 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A Few Of The Benefits We Offer

Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Director, Product Management (PXDP60)

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 5 years of Product Management experience

Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products
